facts: Enron Broadband Services built an 18,000-mile global fiber network that is near completion.
The company currently operates 25 pooling points across the United States, Tokyo, London, Brussels, Amsterdam, Paris, Dusseldorf and Frankfurt.
Enron expects to add at least 10 more pooling points in 2001.
The Enron Intelligent Network operates as a network of networks providing switching capacity between independent networks.
The proprietary Broadband Operating System automates the transaction process from initial capacity request to electronic billing and funds transfer.
Enron Broadband Services is testing the first commercially sound premium content-on-demand service.
